invariants.title: Runtime signing domains and verified bytecode match every active deployment.
Deposits, disputes, debts, and withdrawals conserve enforceable value under adversarial calls.
Canonical codecs, hashes, proofs, identities, and routing math are deterministic and reject non-canonical inputs.
Platform time, configuration, process, logging, and secret boundaries cannot inject nondeterminism or hide fatal failure.
Both peers deterministically converge under collision, duplicate, resend, and restart.
Only validator-certified Entity state commits and local Account inputs never enter routing.
Crash and restart restore the exact durable head without torn authority or replay drift.
Queued, dropped, and delivered WebSocket sends cannot duplicate or lose a financial envelope.
Every participant maintains an authenticated relay fail-safe; user-to-hub, hub-to-hub, and market-maker-to-hub prefer one direct hop and fall back to relay only while direct delivery is unavailable.
Every WebSocket session cryptographically binds both endpoint identities, transport role, audience, and immutable encryption key before carrying authenticated traffic.
Secrets stay out of RuntimeInput, WAL, logs, ordinary responses, and stale socket generations.
Every read, command, reveal, and signer operation is bound to the current authenticated authority generation.
Public faucet routes are explicitly enabled, authority-bounded, and exactly capped.
Every public command and projection is bound to its authenticated caller authority.
Public wallet projections derive only from durable committed state.
Public wallet responses never disclose private keys, mnemonics, or unrevealed secrets.
Public balances, activities, identities, and statuses preserve their committed protocol meaning.
Only canonically normalized and sufficiently finalized chain events become Runtime inputs.
WAL commit precedes every external effect and failed planning cannot partially mutate live state.
A business-invalid command atomically rolls back its candidate, returns an explicit rejection, and never halts or partially mutates unrelated Runtime work.
Registration through payment ends in a durable success or explicit terminal failure receipt.
Offer, fill, cancellation, resolve, and cross-j settlement conserve quantity and authority.
Cancel, back, mode change, stale async completion, and destroy cannot retain or resurrect wallet secrets.
User-visible payment and swap states never claim success or progress beyond durable Runtime evidence.
Production failures are loud and actionable while health, logs, and diagnostics remain secret-free.
Published artifacts, manifests, deployments, verification records, and frozen core bind to the exact source.

findings.title: Active Sepolia EntityProvider uses V3 domains while current signer/source use V1; verifier accepts stale exact_match.
findings.reproduction: Read on-chain BOARD_PROPOSAL_DOMAIN and cancel domain, compare fixed V1/V3 digests, then compare linked deployed bytecode with the current build.

findings.title: Bun -1 queued and 0 dropped send results are interpreted in reverse across direct and relay delivery.
findings.reproduction: Exercise real Bun ServerWebSocket backpressure and trace direct fallback plus relay pending flush for -1 and 0.

findings.title: A malicious endpoint can forward another server's challenge to a victim and take over the victim's authenticated relay session without its signing key.
findings.reproduction: Use two ephemeral Bun relays: forward the target challenge through the malicious endpoint to a real RuntimeWsClient, return the victim-signed hello to the target, and observe the legitimate victim session close with 4009 while the proxy is accepted as the victim.

findings.title: An authenticated session accepts an unsigned post-handshake encryption-key replacement and redirects later envelopes to the attacker's key.
findings.reproduction: Complete signed hello, send a later application frame with the attacker's fromEncryptionPubKey, then prove the attacker decrypts the next outbound entity-input envelope while the original peer receives invalid tag.

findings.title: A transparent direct-WebSocket proxy can forward mutual authentication and then inject post-handshake requests as the victim.
findings.reproduction: Place a transparent proxy between RuntimeWsClient and an honest target, forward the signed challenge, hello, and ACK, then inject recovery_bundle_request on the authenticated upstream socket and observe the target return the bundle while the victim remains connected with no errors.

findings.title: Unified relay authentication derives its audience from an internal localhost URL that can differ from the browser's signed public endpoint.
findings.reproduction: Start the unified API with its default internal relay URL and connect through 127.0.0.1 or a public reverse-proxy hostname; compare the server transcript audience with the browser audience derived from the page URL.

findings.title: An unauthenticated remote Entity proposal is replayed before proposer signature verification and can sticky-halt the receiving Runtime.
findings.reproduction: Queue an active-leader frame whose nested EntityCommand has a zero signature and whose collectedSigs are empty; observe ENTITY_COMMAND_SIGNATURE_MISMATCH halt the Runtime before any proposer precommit is verified, then observe RUNTIME_PROCESS_HALTED on the next input.

findings.title: A rejected second leg may leave first-leg consumption or J-claim CAS nodes in shared pending infrastructure.
findings.reproduction: Stage an atomic pair whose first leg creates consumption or Account J-claim nodes and whose second leg rejects, then commit unrelated retained work and compare live/pending infrastructure node maps against the pre-pair snapshot.

findings.title: Persisted AccountReplica hydration accepts malformed ownership, frame, delta, capacity, nonce, lock, dispute, and proof fields.
findings.reproduction: Encode a valid AccountReplica storage document, mutate each semantic field while preserving schema shape, then run the production codec, storage binding check, and hydration path; 26 of 29 invalid mutations reach live state, including negative allowance or hold values that create positive derived out-capacity.

findings.title: Expected local command rejection can sticky-halt the entire Runtime after mutation begins.
findings.reproduction: Submit duplicate open or a stale/missing-next-hop direct payment and trace failure classification after mutation starts.

findings.title: Insufficient-capacity payment can be consumed while durable activity remains HtlcInitiated/Payment started.
findings.reproduction: Initiate a payment above available capacity and compare ingress receipt, durable activity projection, and user-visible terminal state.

findings.title: Anonymous faucet routes accept caller-selected amounts without a shared enablement, cap, quota, or reservation policy.
findings.reproduction: Submit an anonymous ERC20 faucet request for 999999999999 and observe it reach the funding sink; separately request the full offchain outbound capacity and observe admission rather than rejection.

findings.title: Raw path allowlisting and a caller-selected loopback target let the public watchtower proxy reach operator endpoints.
findings.reproduction: Proxy /api/tower/receipt/../../../api/control/runtime/quiesce to a caller-selected loopback port and observe URL normalization produce an allowed operator POST.

findings.title: Certified routing fees can reach 100% or more and make three unbounded inbound-amount inversion loops hang.
findings.reproduction: Run findRoutes over one edge with feePPM 1000000 and observe it fail to terminate within 300 ms while the doubling BigInt loop continues.

findings.title: Dispute finality clears holds but retains pulls, so reopen followed by cancel or resolve underflows.
findings.reproduction: Finalize an account with one pull and leftHold 100, reopen after finality leaves pulls=1 and hold=0, then pull_cancel fails with left hold underflow.

findings.title: cross_pull_close accepts a caller-selected cumulative source amount when committed fill amounts are absent.
findings.reproduction: Use an authorized source Hub and valid binary with expected source claim 500 but cumulativeSourceAmount 999; observe success, pull deletion, hold zero, and offdelta -999.

findings.title: Wallet numbered registration performs the contract effect before recording its durable Runtime intent.
findings.reproduction: Start numbered registration through FormationPanel, allow registerNumberedEntity to return its receipt, then terminate before the following importReplica RuntimeInput commits; the contract registration survives while Runtime has neither a numberedRegistrationIntent nor the imported replica, and retrying invokes a fresh registration.
